decision_rationale: This is a new adapter/model for DNA-to-RNA sequence analysis, but the provided evidence only concerns biological sequences and RNA prediction tasks, not natural-language text. It is therefore out of scope for a text-bio generative model review.
evidence_snippet: "a lightweight adapter that transforms DNA language models into effective RNA analyzers"; "four RNA prediction tasks"; "codon sequences to RNA properties"; "large-scale language models trained on vast amounts of biological sequence data"; "natural language processing" is only used as analogy
